questions.question: Why might k-means give a different result every time I run it?
evidence: will depend on the initial (random) cluster assignment of each observation

questions.question: What's the time complexity of k-means?
evidence: Relatively efficient: O( tkn), where n is # data samples

questions.question: What are the main downsides of k-means?
evidence: Need to specify K, the number of clusters, in advance
Unable to handle noisy data and outliers

questions.question: How can clustering be used to compress data?
evidence: Using only cluster centers to represent/approximate the whole dataset
Compress new data by finding and save the index of the closest center

questions.question: What three ingredients does any clustering method need?
evidence: Similarity ( s) or distance ( d) measurements
Optimization algorithm to minimize the cost function

questions.question: What is inertia?
evidence: Within-cluster sum-of-squares ( inertia)

questions.question: Why not just try every possible way of assigning points to clusters?
evidence: Find the global optimal but not practical

questions.question: How does k-means decide which cluster a point belongs to?
evidence: assign the data to the cluster with the smallest distance

questions.question: What's the difference between a core point and a border point?
evidence: Has ≥ MinPts within ε-radius (interior anchor)
Falls within ε of core, but has < MinPts neighbors

questions.question: How do I choose epsilon for DBSCAN?
evidence: Order points by distance to kth neighbor
Sharp elbow identifies optimal ε

questions.question: When does density-based clustering break down?
evidence: Single ε cannot fit multiple densities
Too Large ε: Inadvertently merges adjacent dense

questions.question: Does a point count itself when measuring density?
evidence: Crucially counts the query point itself

questions.question: Which clustering method can find spiral or ring-shaped clusters?
evidence: Discovers interlaced spirals, rings, and letters

questions.question: What makes a point an outlier in DBSCAN?
evidence: Neither core nor border; isolated outlier

questions.question: Walk me through the agglomerative clustering algorithm.
evidence: Treat each data point as a cluster
Merge the two closest clusters (search the proximity matrix to identify the closest clusters)

questions.question: What kind of cluster shapes is single link good at?
evidence: Can handle non-elliptical shapes

questions.question: What are the pros and cons of complete link (MAX)?
evidence: Less sensitive to noise and outliers
Tends to break large clusters

questions.question: How does Ward's method decide which clusters to merge?
evidence: based on the increase in squared error when two clusters are merged

questions.question: How much memory and time does hierarchical clustering need?
evidence: O(N2) space since it uses the proximity matrix
Complexity can be reduced to O(N2 log(N) ) time

questions.question: How do I get the number of clusters from a dendrogram?
evidence: The number of vertical lines your horizontal line intersects equals your final number of clusters

questions.question: Can hierarchical clustering fix a bad merge later?
evidence: Once a decision is made to combine two clusters, it cannot be undone

questions.question: Why bother evaluating clusters at all?
evidence: To avoid finding patterns in noise

questions.question: What's the difference between external and internal cluster evaluation?
evidence: Supervised evaluation , which uses an external criterion
Unsupervised evaluation , which uses an internal criterion

questions.question: What's the formula for the Rand index?
evidence: Rand_Index = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)

questions.question: Does the silhouette score need ground truth labels?
evidence: Evaluates how well-separated and cohesive clusters are without requiring ground-truth labels

questions.question: When can the silhouette coefficient be misleading?
evidence: Can be misleading for non-convex clusters
Sensitive to distance metric choice

questions.question: Why is there a trade-off between SSE and BSS?
evidence: Total sum of squares (TSS) = SSE + BSS is fixed for a given dataset

questions.question: If k-means swaps the cluster numbers, is the clustering wrong?
evidence: The k-means outcome is still correct but there is no direct match with the known assignments

questions.question: What's the difference between multi-class and multi-label classification?
evidence: Each input can belong to multiple classes simultaneously

questions.question: How does ID3 pick which feature to split on?
evidence: Choose the feature with the highest Information Gain

evidence: Stop expanding a node when all the records belong to the same class

questions.question: How do decision trees handle numeric features like income?
evidence: consider all possible splits and finds the best cut

questions.question: What prediction does a leaf with no training samples make?
evidence: If leaf is empty, assign the default class

questions.question: Why doesn't KNN need a training step?
evidence: there is no functional model

evidence: If k is too small, sensitive to noise points
If k is too large, neighborhood may include points from other classes

questions.question: How can nearest neighbor search be sped up?

Locality Sensitive Hashing (LSH)
